scripts.lint:workspace: pnpm --dir apps/api lint && pnpm --dir apps/web lint
scripts.typecheck:workspace: pnpm --dir packages/contracts typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/api-client typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/api exec tsc --noEmit --incremental false --pretty false && pnpm --dir apps/web exec tsc --noEmit --incremental false --pretty false
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --dir packages/contracts test && pnpm --dir packages/api-client test && pnpm --dir packages/theme-tokens test && pnpm --dir apps/api exec vitest run src && pnpm --dir apps/api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.pools.ts
scripts.test:database:owned: pnpm --dir apps/api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.environment-integration.ts --disableConsoleIntercept
scripts.test:pt:owned: pnpm --dir apps/api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.pt.ts --disableConsoleIntercept
scripts.test:finance:owned: pnpm --dir apps/api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.finance.ts --disableConsoleIntercept
scripts.test:recovery:owned: pnpm --dir apps/api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.recovery.ts --disableConsoleIntercept
scripts.test:cf:owned: pnpm --dir apps/api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.member-applications.ts --disableConsoleIntercept
scripts.build:deploy:web: pnpm prepare:checks && pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
